title: Weekly Vessel Valuations Report, September 8 2026
summary:
Main
Bulkers
Bulker S&P activity remained busy this week, with a steady flow of Capesize,Supramax and Handysize transactions changing hands amid broadly resilient sentiment. Values were broadly stable with the exception of mid age Handy BCs; values dipped in response to the China Spirit's soft pricing. Capesize Navios Pollux (180,700 DWT, 2009, STX Offshore) sold DD Due to Chinese buyers for USD 30.75 mil, VV Value USD 30.8 mil.
